title: Intersection Bounds for BPS Strings in Six-Dimensional Supergravity
summary: In six-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=(1,0)$ supergravity, the structure of tensor moduli space is governed by primitive BPS string charges known as BPS generators and their intersection pairing. We derive bounds on the intersection numbers of these generators from a purely effective field theory (EFT) perspective. Although gauge anomaly cancellation constrains intersections between generators supporting gauge algebras, bounds for E-strings intersecting generators with self-intersection numbers $-2$ and $-3$ have previously remained incomplete.
